summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Calendly popup integration and expandable Services cards. All features working correctly with proper UTM tracking parameters.
passed_tests: Services room loads with 4 service cards showing image, number (01-04), title, and 'Explore More' button by default
Service cards are collapsed by default (description, bullets, CTA hidden)
Clicking 'Explore More' expands card in-place, revealing description, bullets, and CTA button
Expand button label toggles to 'Show Less' with Minus icon, aria-expanded changes to true
Accordion behavior: opening second card automatically collapses first card (only one open at a time)
Verified via DOM: only one service-card has data-expanded='true' at any time
Hero 'Let's Talk' button is <button> element (not <a> link)
Hero 'Let's Talk' opens Calendly popup with utm_source=HeroRoom and utm_content=opener
Desktop nav 'Schedule a Conversation' button opens Calendly popup with utm_source=NavBar and utm_content=schedule_a_conversation
Mobile nav 'Schedule a Conversation' (via hamburger menu) opens Calendly popup with same UTM parameters
Service #1 (Agile Delivery Leadership) CTA opens Calendly with utm_source=ServicesRoom and utm_content=01_Agile
All 4 service cards have correct UTM content mapping: 01_Agile, 02_PO, 03_Speaking, 04_Tech
Calendly script loads at app mount (window.Calendly object available)
All Calendly popups open as iframe overlays (no page navigation)
Regression check: Hero primary CTA 'See the Work' still smooth-scrolls to Projects section (6304px scroll)
Regression check: Hero primary CTA does NOT open Calendly popup (correct behavior)
Home page loads all rooms without console errors (Hero, Introduction, Values, Services, Testimonials, Logos, Gallery, Impact, Projects)
No React warnings or application errors in console (only Calendly third-party warnings)
